{{Top|leg}}
The '''Recent Morrt Project Data-Gathering Results and Conclusions''' was a file written by [[Gara Petothel]], the [[Slicer/Legends|code slicer]] responsible for planting wrong information in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] databanks; which led to the destruction of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]]. The file was a report on the findings of the [[Morrt-class parasite-droid]]s, which [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces secretly unleashed on the New Republic ships in order to trace their whereabouts. The file was sent to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]], captain of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|Implacable]]. After reading it, he immediately ordered preparations to attack [[Folor]], where a New Republic [[Folor Base|training base]] was secretly located.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
